Which physical device is used is configured in the profile, not here. Connecting an already connected device is harmless. Runs as a background job holding that device. tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU). The frame is also added to the image history (get_recent_images). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

tools.name: start_sequence
tools.description: Starts the advanced sequence that is loaded (load_sequence) or built (add_target) and returns as soon as it runs; it then runs on its own for hours, moving the mount, camera, focuser and guider. NINA validates the sequence first (devices connected, filters exist, ...) and refuses with the issues listed; skip_validation bypasses that check (not recommended). While it runs, other hardware and change tools are refused unless force is passed. Monitor with get_status, get_sequence and get_recent_images; stop with stop_sequence (or stop_all). Finished items are skipped on a new start: reset_sequence first to run everything again. Refused while a job started over MCP (slew, capture, autofocus, focuser move, filter change, guiding start, switch) still runs: wait for it with get_job or stop it with cancel_job. A running camera cooling job does not block the start.

tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU). The frame is also added to the image history (get_recent_images). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. By default the frame is analysed but not saved; save: true writes it like a normal LIGHT frame (the file path appears in get_recent_images once it is written). Omitted gain/offset use the profile defaults; omitted binning keeps the camera's current binning. Runs as a background job holding the camera and refused while a focuser move or filter change runs; the default wait covers short exposures, poll get_job for long ones. For many frames build a sequence with add_target instead.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel (see get_status), e.g. "Ha" or "L". Omit to keep the current filter.

gain.description: Camera gain (driver units). Omit for the profile default gain.

offset.description: Camera offset (driver units). Omit for the profile default offset.

binning.description: Symmetric binning factor (1-4; 2 = 2x2). Omit to keep the current binning.

save.description: Save the frame to disk as a LIGHT frame. Default false (snapshot, analysed only).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish before returning (0-55, default 30). If it is still running, the result holds the job id: poll get_job. The operation continues in the background either way.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: start_sequence
tools.description: Starts the advanced sequence that is loaded (load_sequence) or built (add_target) and returns as soon as it runs; it then runs on its own for hours, moving the mount, camera, focuser and guider. Finished items are skipped on a new start: reset_sequence first to run everything again. A running camera cooling job does not block the start.

tools.name: add_target

Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). tools.name: stop_all
tools.description: Emergency stop. In this order: stops the advanced sequence (so it cannot start its next item), cancels every background job, aborts the running camera exposure, stops the mount if it is slewing and halts a focuser move started over MCP. Every step runs even if an earlier one fails; the result lists each step. It does NOT park the mount, stop guiding, warm the camera or disconnect anything; an idle mount is left alone (note that aborting a slew stops tracking on some mount drivers). Safe to repeat. Use it whenever the user says stop/abort or something looks wrong (unexpected movement, collision risk, clouds/rain). This tool is never refused: together with cancel_job it stays available in read-only mode, and it needs no force while a sequence runs. Afterwards check get_status.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

force.description: Run even though the advanced sequence is running. Only set this when the user explicitly asked for it; without it the call is refused while a sequence runs.

tools.name: list_target_templates
tools.description: Names of the saved target templates (deep sky object containers prepared by the user with their preferred instructions: centering, autofocus triggers, exposure blocks, dithering). Pass one as 'template' to add_target to reuse the user's own imaging recipe instead of building an exposure plan.

tools.name: start_sequence
tools.description: Starts the advanced sequence that is loaded (load_sequence) or built (add_target) and returns as soon as it runs; it then runs on its own for hours, moving the mount, camera, focuser and guider. Finished items are skipped on a new start: reset_sequence first to run everything again. Refused while a job started over MCP (slew, capture, autofocus, focuser move, filter change, guiding start, switch) still runs: wait for it with get_job or stop it with cancel_job. A running camera cooling job does not block the start.

skip_validation.description: Start even when NINA's sequence validation reports issues. Default false.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). tools.name: capture_image
tools.description: Takes one exposure with the imaging camera (changing the filter first when 'filter' is set) and returns its statistics in outcome.data (HFR in pixels, star count, mean/median ADU). The frame is also added to the image history (get_recent_images). Use it for test frames: framing, focus check, exposure check. By default the frame is analysed but not saved; save: true writes it like a normal LIGHT frame (the file path appears in get_recent_images once it is written). Omitted gain/offset use the profile defaults; omitted binning keeps the camera's current binning. Runs as a background job holding the camera and refused while a focuser move or filter change runs; the default wait covers short exposures, poll get_job for long ones. For many frames build a sequence with add_target instead.

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel (see get_status), e.g. "Ha" or "L". Omit to keep the current filter.

gain.description: Camera gain (driver units). Omit for the profile default gain.

offset.description: Camera offset (driver units). Omit for the profile default offset.

binning.description: Symmetric binning factor (1-4; 2 = 2x2). Omit to keep the current binning.

save.description: Save the frame to disk as a LIGHT frame. Default false (snapshot, analysed only).

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

dither_every.description: Exposure plan only: dither after every N frames (0 = never, max 32 like NINA). Default 0.

tools.name: start_sequence

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.

name.description: Target name used for the sequence container and file names, e.g. "M 42".

ra.description: J2000 right ascension in HOURS (0 <= ra < 24): a number like 5.5883 or a sexagesimal string like "05h35m17.3s", "5:35:17.3" or "5 35 17.3". Degrees are not accepted: divide degrees by 15.

dec.description: J2000 declination in DEGREES (-90..90): a number like -5.391 or a sexagesimal string like "-05°23'28\"", "-5:23:28", "-5d23m28s" or "-5 23 28". The sign applies to the whole value ("-00:30:00" is -0.5°).

rotation_degrees.description: Desired sky position angle of the camera in degrees (0 <= x < 360), used by slew-and-center with a rotator. Omit to keep the default.

template.description: Name of a saved target template (list_target_templates). Mutually exclusive with exposures.

exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

binning.description: Symmetric binning (1-4). Omit for 1x1 / profile default.

slew_and_center.description: Exposure plan only: slew, plate solve and center (and rotate) before imaging. Default true.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

autofocus_at_start.description: Exposure plan only: run autofocus after centering. Default false.

tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). exposures.description: Exposure plan: one block per entry, executed in order. Mutually exclusive with template.

exposure_seconds.description: Exposure time of each frame in seconds (0.0001-3600).

filter.description: Filter name as configured in the filter wheel, e.g. "Ha". Omit for no filter change.

gain.description: Camera gain. Omit for the profile default.

offset.description: Camera offset. Omit for the profile default.

start_guiding.description: Exposure plan only: start guiding before the exposures. Default true.

tools.name: add_target
